query: 社会影响评估 社会影响评估 衡量企业识别、分析、管理及监测其运营和特定项目（正负面）社会后果的能力。重点考察评估方法的科学性、负面风险分级、缓释计划的有效性及项目后的影响评估。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的社会影响评估框架（SIA）；在项目立项前执行正式的风险分级；针对识别的负面影响（如搬迁、生计破坏）制定了详细的缓释计划；且披露了项目实施后的社会成效审计或后评估。 • 1分（合格）：在重大项目实施中包含基础的社会风险调查或可行性研究，具备定性的影响描述和初步的补偿/缓解措施，但缺乏标准化的评估方法论或系统的后评估追踪。 • 0分（不合格）：无社会影响评估相关披露，或仅关注经济/环境评估而忽略社会维度。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：社会影响评估机制覆盖 >80% 的重大投资项目、新建工程、并购活动或高风险运营区域。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对法律强制要求的项目执行，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 社会影响评估 社会风险评估 搬迁安置 生计恢复 人权影响评估 项目后评估 社会风险尽职调查 缓释计划 SIA HRIA social impact assessment SIA social risk assessment resettlement plan livelihood restoration human rights impact assessment post-evaluation project social due diligence HRIA 是否有正式社会影响评估（SIA）框架或方法？ 重大项目立项前是否做社会风险分级？ 对搬迁、生计破坏等负面影响的缓释计划是什么？ 是否开展项目后社会成效审计或后评估？ 机制覆盖多少重大投资、新建或并购项目？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '社会影响评估'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式社会影响评估（SIA）框架或方法？ 重大项目立项前是否做社会风险分级？ 对搬迁、生计破坏等负面影响的缓释计划是什么？ 是否开展项目后社会成效审计或后评估？ 机制覆盖多少重大投资、新建或并购项目？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有环评而忽略社会维度；仅有社区公益捐赠；仅有社区参与活动报道；仅有人权政策口号而无项目评估；区分：社会影响评估针对运营/项目正负面影响的识别分级缓释与后评估；社区参与战略是日常社区关系框架；实质性评估是公司级ESG议题排序。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TO HELP MAINTAIN ECOSYSTEM HEALTH

results.section: Improve ESG governance structure / Ensure fulfillment of social responsibility
results.text: We build a systematic ESG governance structure at the governance, management and executive levels. The Board of Directors supervises ESG matters and assumes overall responsibility for ESG strategies and reporting, and authorizes the Audit Committee to be the professional committee for overseeing ESG management. The Audit Committee regularly reports to the Board of Directors on major issues related to ESG work; the management is responsible for the specific implementation of ESG strategies and goals. The ESG functional departments of the headquarters form an ESG working group, which is responsible for the development of specific ESG work in their respective work areas; each subsidiary conducts ESG work in its territories under the guidance of the ESG working group. The establishment of the ESG governance structure ensures that the environmental and social risks involved in various businesses are managed, and enables the effective implementation of ESG concepts and strategies.

results.section: Concerted efforts to improve people's well-being
results.text: In line with the principle of equal employment, the Group provides fair and competitive salary and benefits for our employees with adequate evaluation on their occupational competence and market conditions. In order to fully guarantee employees' lives and arouse their enthusiasm, other than meeting the national and regional standards of the social security and welfare where the Group operates, we also provide staff with additional benefits such as communication fee subsidies, meal subsidies, t r a n s p o r t a t i o n s u b s i d i e s , f e s t i v a l s u b s i d i e s , heatstroke prevention and cooling fees, heating fees, free breakfast and overtime dinner.
